newsitem.title: USA: CSCE to raise marGins on March "C" coffee futures.
newsitem.headline: CSCE to raise marGins on March "C" coffee futures.

text.p: Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange said Thursday it will raise margins on the March "C" coffee contracts by $250 to $2,750, effective Jan 31.
The margin on all other coffee contracts will be increased by $250 to $2,250, the exchange said in a statement.
The changes comes just two weeks after the exchange raised the spot margin by $750 and the margins on all other contracts by $250.
For customers who are not exchange members or a member of the trade, margins will be 140 percent above trade rates, CSCE said. ((--Patricia Avidan, New York Commodities Desk, 212 859 1640))
